Assign when the study characterises, measures, models, or reviews the effects, harms, hazards, or risks arising from a climate variable (e.g. changes in temperature, precipitation, humidity, sea level, or wind) or a climate-related extreme event (e.g. heatwave, flood, drought, storm, wildfire, extreme cold) on human health, ecosystems, economies, or societies. Do not assign for the health effects of a non-climate exposure on its own (e.g. air pollution or chemicals with no climatic driver in the causal pathway).
